svg.text: Transfer Family SFTP with Custom Identity Provider
PUBLIC endpoint, SSH public key only, source IP allow list checked by a Lambda IdP, run modes (always / scheduled / manual) and alarms
auth failure / IP denied / IdP error
create / delete the server and its alarms
